**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (fallback insert).**

- **Investigation:** The outline showed no insurance heading; the miscellaneous provisions (Sections 13–30, read in full at `sec-12`) contain term, termination, assignment, notices, venue, force majeure, etc., but no coverage covenant. Exhibits A and B are pricing placeholders. Text searches for "insur" returned only the recital reference to third-party "mortgage insurers".
- **Direction:** TrueLink (counterparty) hosts our Web Site and transmits Client data through the Interface — a vendor that processes our data with no insurance is walk-away territory, so an insert is warranted.
- **Target level:** Fallback (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000) — the shortest complete change. I deliberately omitted the preferred CGL limits, workers' compensation, certificates, "at its own expense" and survival tail, since no selected element requires them.
- **Placement:** New Section 31 after Force Majeure (p0097), so the existing "Sections 1 and 5 through 30" survival reference and all other numbering remain intact.
